subject: Customer portal kickoff
body: We want account login, invoice history, and a support-request form in the first pilot. Please treat downloadable invoices as in scope; payment processing is not part of phase one.

subject: Inventory integration kickoff
body: We need warehouse stock quantities reflected on our storefront. Initial target is a 15-minute sync and a pilot on December 8, subject to warehouse API access.

subject: Dashboard kickoff and KPIs
body: The MVP dashboard needs weekly revenue, conversion rate, and support response time, broken down by region. Our initial target is a December 10 stakeholder demo.

subject: Re: Customer portal kickoff
body: Confirmed. We will prototype login, invoice list/download, and support requests. We will exclude online payment processing. Please identify your final approval contact for design changes.

subject: Re: Inventory integration kickoff
body: We can build the integration against sandbox endpoints first. Please send API credentials and clarify whether storefront updates may lag during overnight warehouse maintenance.

subject: Re: Dashboard kickoff and KPIs
body: We will use weekly aggregates for the MVP and show three KPI cards by region. We need the canonical revenue definition before finalizing the data model.

subject: Design review feedback
body: The login and invoice screens look good. Could we also add a chatbot? This is a request for discussion, not approval to change scope.

subject: Warehouse API access
body: Sandbox API key is provisioned; production credentials are still pending security review. Warehouse downtime is normally 01:00–01:30 EST.

subject: Revenue metric definition
body: Use recognized revenue, net of refunds, attributed to the order’s billing region. Do not use gross checkout value. Please confirm this definition in the dashboard spec.

subject: Re: Design review feedback
body: A chatbot would require new testing and privacy review. We recommend deferring it to phase two. We will not implement it without written approval.

subject: Sync implementation plan
body: We will queue changes during warehouse downtime and retry after recovery. We still target 15-minute refresh intervals, with a delayed status indicator when updates are stale.

subject: Re: Revenue metric definition
body: Confirmed: recognized revenue minus refunds, grouped by billing region. Our data validation work will use that definition.

subject: Re: Design review feedback
body: Approved: defer chatbot to phase two. Keep phase-one delivery focused on login, invoice history/download, and the support form.

subject: Inventory identifiers mismatch
body: We discovered some storefront SKUs use leading zeros while warehouse IDs do not. Please do not normalize away leading zeros without a mapping table.

subject: Request to add churn metric
body: Would it be possible to include customer churn in the December demo? This is only a proposal; I need the product director to sign off.

subject: Pilot date proposal
body: Testing the invoice download flow may take longer than estimated. I propose moving the pilot from December 1 to December 5; this is not yet approved.

subject: Re: Inventory identifiers mismatch
body: Reproduced. We will preserve SKU strings and build an explicit SKU mapping table. This blocks reconciliation testing until Nova supplies the authoritative crosswalk.

subject: Re: Request to add churn metric
body: Churn requires customer-status history we do not currently have. Recommend excluding it from the MVP unless the product director approves and provides data.

subject: Re: Pilot date proposal
body: The December 5 pilot is approved, on the condition that security sign-off and invoice-download QA are complete by December 3.

subject: SKU crosswalk file ready
body: I attached the approved crosswalk to our shared workspace. Please use its exact string identifiers in reconciliation tests. Production credentials remain pending.

subject: Churn metric decision
body: Product director declined churn for this milestone. Keep the three agreed KPIs for the December 10 demo; revisit churn after launch.

subject: Invoice download bug found
body: QA found that invoice PDFs sometimes download under the wrong filename. We are fixing this before December 3. No evidence of cross-account data exposure, but security review is still open.

subject: Reconciliation results
body: With the crosswalk applied, 98.6% of 500 test SKUs reconcile. Seven exceptions remain under investigation. We cannot mark data reconciliation complete yet.

subject: Data quality issue: missing West region
body: The analytics feed omits West region records for November 6–9. We have opened a data ticket and need the source export reissued before the demo.

subject: Security review owner
body: Our security lead Jordan will perform sign-off. Please send the completed penetration-test summary by December 2. Jordan has not approved the pilot yet.

subject: Production API credentials approved
body: Security approved production API credentials today. They will be delivered through the secrets vault, not email. This removes the credential blocker.

subject: Re: Data quality issue: missing West region
body: Our data team has the missing export and will send a corrected feed by November 20. Do not mark the gap resolved until you verify it.

subject: Invoice filename bug fixed
body: Fix merged and regression tests passed for the invoice filename issue. Security review and final pilot go/no-go are still pending.

subject: Reconciliation update
body: All seven SKU exceptions are now resolved in staging. We still need production cutover rehearsal before calling the integration pilot-ready.

subject: West region backfill validated
body: The corrected data feed includes West region for November 6–9 and our validation checks passed. That blocker is closed. One open item: finalize role-based dashboard access.

subject: Confirm December pilot checklist
body: To be clear, December 5 is conditionally approved, not a final go decision. Please provide evidence of QA and security sign-off before December 3.

subject: Pilot readiness expectations
body: December 8 remains the target pilot date. Sign-off depends on a successful cutover rehearsal and confirmation that stale-stock alerts are visible to operators.

subject: Dashboard access requirement
body: For the December 10 demo, executives can see all regions, but regional managers must only see their own region. Please finish permissions testing by December 7.

subject: Security review progress
body: Initial penetration-test review is complete, but two low-severity findings need documented mitigations. Final sign-off remains pending.

subject: Cutover rehearsal scheduled
body: We have scheduled the production cutover rehearsal for December 3. We will test rollback and verify the stale-stock alert. This is a schedule confirmation, not rehearsal completion.

subject: Permissions implementation update
body: Role-based filtering is implemented in staging. We have not yet completed negative-access tests; permissions testing remains open for December 7.
